questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A snowboard jump path is y = 3x^2 + (2)x + (-3). Find y at x = -2.
questions.q_zh: 单板跳跃路线 y = 3x^2 + (2)x + (-3)，求 x = -2 时的 y。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Along a marked summit survey, snow depths form an arithmetic sequence: 12, 16, 20 cm. What is the 15th depth in cm?
questions.q_zh: 一条有标记的山顶调查线上，雪深成等差数列 12、16、20 厘米，第 15 个读数几厘米？
questions.qtype_zh: 等差数列第 n 项

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A model of glacier thickness is H = 80 × (1/2)^t metres. After how many years t is H = 10 m?
questions.q_zh: 冰川厚度模型为 H=80×(1/2)^t 米，多少年后厚度为 10 米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A summit snow sample sequence is geometric with first mass 3 g and ratio 2. What is the sum of the first 5 masses in grams?
questions.q_zh: 山顶雪样质量成等比数列，首项 3 克、公比 2，前 5 项总质量几克？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A hut has 5 distinct summit photos. Flora chooses 2 for a display, with order irrelevant. How many pairs are possible?
questions.q_zh: 小屋有 5 张不同的山顶照片，Flora 选 2 张展示，不计顺序，有多少种选法？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A quadratic model of a snow arch is h = -2(x - 3)^2 + 18. At what horizontal coordinate x is the arch highest?
questions.q_zh: 雪拱二次模型为 h=-2(x-3)^2+18，水平坐标 x 为多少时最高？
questions.explain_en: The squared term is zero at x = 3, giving the maximum height = 18. The maximizing coordinate = 3.
questions.explain_zh: x=3 时平方项为零，高度达到最大值 18，故 x=3。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: In a summit instrument model, a signal grows from 4 to 64 units by doubling once each hour. How many hours pass?
questions.q_zh: 山顶仪器模型中，信号每小时加倍，从 4 单位增至 64 单位，共过几小时？
questions.explain_en: 4 × 2^4 = 64, so the elapsed time = 4.

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: A glacier survey estimates mean snow depth from random samples. Why use random locations rather than only the deepest drifts?
questions.q_zh: 冰川调查用样本估计平均雪深，为什么随机选地点而不是只选最深雪堆？
choices: To guarantee all readings are identical
To ensure the mean is the maximum
choices_zh: 确保平均数等于最大值
questions.explain_en: Random sampling reduces bias from deliberately choosing unusual locations.
questions.explain_zh: 随机抽样可减少刻意选择特殊地点带来的偏差。
questions.qtype_zh: 科学推理/统计（相关≠因果/抽样/置信区间）

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Flora compares a linear and an exponential glacier-thickness model. Which observation best indicates exponential decay?
questions.q_zh: Flora 比较冰川厚度的线性与指数模型，哪种现象最符合指数衰减？
choices: The same fraction of thickness is lost each year
The same number of metres is lost each year
choices_zh: 每年减少相同比例的厚度
questions.explain_en: Exponential decay has a constant multiplicative factor over equal time intervals.
questions.explain_zh: 指数衰减在相等时间间隔内有固定的乘法因子。
questions.qtype_zh: 函数模型识别（线性/指数）
